title: Status and feedback
description: Status and feedback widgets for the Taskscape task manager: small count badges, thin progress bars, a 12px inline spinner, and empty-state panels shown when a pane, list, trash or search has nothing to display. Grouped from the 21 rows in rows-status.json.

variants.name: Subtask progress badge, bordered
variants.component: Badge (rows on draft-inspector, main-window and task-list; component recorded as '?' on multi-inspector, filter-panel and trash)
variants.description: Bordered pill showing how many subtasks of a parent task are done, as '{done} / {total}' with no spaces. Read-only. Merged across six rows because the measured look and behaviour match; the component name is unknown ('?') on three of them, and the border colour and radius are not recorded on filter-panel and trash (estimated only).
variants.look: px-space-3 pill; bordered; font 600 11px/16.5px; text colour oklch(0.62 0.013 264) light and oklch(0.57 0.011 262) dark (main-window only); box about 32x18 (793,245); radius not recorded on main-window; border colour not recorded on filter-panel; chip border and radius estimated on trash.
variants.behaviour: Read-only, no actions. Title or tooltip reads '{doneChildren} of {children.length} subtasks done'. Shown only when the row has visible children (task-list).

variants.name: Attachment count badge
variants.description: Attachment count on a task row, with a paperclip icon. Only one row exists and it was not observed with attachments, so the look is unrecorded. Kept separate because it carries an icon that the subtask badge does not.
variants.look: px-space-2 padding; attach_file icon at size 13, weight 500, followed by the count digit. Measurements not recorded.
states: shown when task.attachments.length > 0 (no recorded row has attachments)

variants.name: Selected count badge, accent round
variants.description: Large filled round badge in the multi-select summary header that shows how many tasks are selected. Display only.
variants.look: 28x28 circle at (873,64); background oklch(0.6 0.2 255); text oklch(0.99 0.005 255); font 700 13px/19.5px; class px-space-5 h-8 min-w-8 text-[13px] font-bold.

variants.name: List name tag, outline
variants.description: Grey bordered pill beside each selected task that names the list the task belongs to. Rendered only when the list id resolves to a name. Four rows on the same screen; the exact text is not recorded in the tree (the shot reads 'Errands').
variants.look: font 600 10.5px/15.75px; text colour oklch(0.62 0.013 264); box about 58x18 at x 1081; radius 4.375px; class px-space-4 shrink-0; grey bordered pill.
examples: Errands (from screenshot; text not recorded in tree)

variants.name: Match count badge, recessed
variants.description: Count of matching rows on the General tab in the settings sidebar, shown only while a settings search has matches. Display only. The value comes from the settings-search recording and is not confirmed from source.
states: shown only when searching and matches > 0

variants.name: Thin progress bar, 84px
variants.component: ProgressBar (component recorded as '?' on filter-panel and trash)
variants.description: Thin determinate bar about 84px wide showing the done ratio of a list or pane, with no text in the bar itself. Merged across five rows: the measured or estimated look and read-only behaviour match. The draft-inspector row pairs the bar with a separate '25 %' label, which is not part of the bar. The task-list row also has an empty state at value 0.
variants.look: 84px wide; track about 4px tall (84x4 measured on main-window and draft-inspector; estimated on task-list, filter-panel and trash); light grey track; blue fill (colour not measured).
states: 25% filled (main-window default, task-list, draft-inspector, filter-panel, trash)
about 33% filled (main-window split right pane, value 0.3333)
examples: No text. Value 0.25 (2 of 8 done on draft-inspector, paired with a '25 %' label).

variants.name: Pane empty state, no icon
variants.component: EmptyState (no-lists row) and EmptyState (no-list-selected row, component name as recorded)
variants.description: Full-pane message with a title and a muted subtitle, no icon, shown in place of the task pane. Used for 'no lists yet' and for 'no list selected'. The no-list-selected state is code-path only and its look is not recorded, so it is grouped here on matching className and behaviour only.
variants.look: className bg-surface-2l dark:bg-surface-2d; title 15px font medium, secondary colour, box 84x23 at (388,380); subtitle 12.5px muted, box 209x19 at (326,407); panel 860x715 at y=46 (no-lists state).
variants.behaviour: No actions on the empty state. The New list icon button in the title bar is the way forward; for no-list-selected, pick a list tab.
examples: No lists yet / Create a list to start adding tasks
No list selected / Pick a list tab to view its tasks (code path only)

variants.name: List empty state, icon and hint
variants.description: Empty-list message in the task list scroll area with a landscape icon above a title and a keyboard hint. The searching variant (icon search_off, title 'No matches in {list.name}') is code-path only and not in any recorded tree, so it is not shown in the recorded look.
variants.look: icon span at (415,182) 30x30, font 400 30px/30px, colour oklch(0.62 0.013 264); className pt-24 pb-10; iconSize 30; title and hint grey and centred (visual).
variants.behaviour: No actions on the empty state.
examples: Press + or ⌘N to add a task, or ⌘↩ anywhere to capture one
Press + or ⌘N to add a task (variant without the capture hint)

variants.name: Trash empty state, icon and title
variants.description: Message in the trash list body when there are no root items, with a delete icon and a single title. It also shows a loading title while the store loads. No subtitle. Look is estimated from code, not measured.
variants.look: icon delete at size 28; className py-16; no subtitle; not measured.

variants.name: Search no-results empty state
variants.description: Panel shown in place of the settings groups when a settings search matches nothing in any pane. Carries a search icon and a subtitle quoting the query. Not in any recorded state, so the look is not recorded.
states: shown only when searching with no results (not in any recorded state)
examples: No settings match / Nothing here for “<query>”. (curly quotes)

variants.name: Inline spinner, 12px, in capture button
variants.description: Small spinner that replaces the screenshot icon inside the Shot button in the attachments section while a screen capture runs. Only one row.
